description: Legacy development fields that the schema-1 pack vocabulary cannot express, in whole or in part. The parity comparison does not cover the residue. delivered is the part of the field the development pack carries since GP-10B-1, or null when it carries none of it. residue is what stays outside the pack, and owner is the task that owns that residue next. gp09Gap is the GP-09 vocabulary gap code that reports the field in a state that uses it. inDefaultState is true for a field observed in the default legacy state and false for a legacy field the default state does not use, listed so that its owner is on record.

owners.GP-25: Pack policy contribution contract (provisional number; Runtime task 1a883c04-0905-4b36-a57b-12d45fdfd59f)

entries.subject: office_role
entries.reason: Authored responsibility statements of an office role. A pack role has a title and a description only.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Runtime role name, such as software-architect. Missing from the GP-09 gap list and recorded here; the frozen GP-09 profile is not edited.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Definition version of the Runtime role, which also versions its guidance.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Capability order. The Runtime stores an ordered list and a pack role holds a set; membership is compared, order is not.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Tools the Runtime role may call. A pack role declares no tool or integration.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Model policy of the Runtime role.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Runtime limits and constraints: maxIterations, maxCostMicros and timeoutSeconds.

entries.subject: runtime_role
entries.reason: Role guidance, the system instructions shipped as system.md: its text, digest and version.

entries.subject: agent
entries.reason: Whether the Runtime agent is enabled. A pack agent is a declaration and creates no Runtime agent.

entries.subject: task_kind
entries.delivered: The routes feature -> delivery, bugfix -> bugfix, research -> discovery and release -> release, each as the taskType of the workflow of that ID.
entries.reason: Routing of a task kind to a pipeline. A pack workflow names one task type, so the second kind of a pipeline that routes two has no place in the pack.

entries.subject: pipeline
entries.delivered: One task kind per pipeline, as the taskType of its workflow: the routes feature -> delivery, bugfix -> bugfix, research -> discovery and release -> release.
entries.residue: The second task kind of the delivery pipeline: the route maintenance -> delivery.
entries.reason: One pipeline routes several task kinds; a pack workflow names one task type.

entries.subject: pipeline
entries.reason: Whether the pipeline is enforced or guidance.

entries.subject: stage
entries.reason: Stage name. A pack workflow stage is an ID and a role.

entries.subject: stage
entries.reason: Check semantics: the checks a stage must satisfy.

entries.subject: stage
entries.reason: Approval semantics: whether completing the stage requires an approval.

entries.subject: stage
entries.reason: Approval semantics: whether the agent assigned to the stage is barred from deciding its approval. The default state does not use it.

entries.subject: stage
entries.reason: Separation constraint: earlier stages whose agent may not do this stage. The default state does not use it.
